correctness.rationale: The exact cumulant generating function for a flat signed spectrum expands as \(t^2/2+\sqrt2\,\rho t^3/3+t^4/2+O(t^5)\). Independent series inversion gives the rate function \(I(a)=a^2/2-\sqrt2\,\rho a^3/3+(\rho^2-1/2)a^4+O(a^5)\). Standard exponential tilting on the stated moderate-deviation range then yields the displayed cubic/quartic extreme-tail correction and its shifted-Gumbel transfer. The positive and balanced special cases are consistent with exact chi-square and variance-gamma laws.
